description.zh:
业务类型，取值：

- **cdn_log_access_l1**（默认值）：用户访问日志。
- **cdn_log_er**：边缘程序日志。
- **cdn_log_waf**：WAF拦截日志。
description.en:
The type of the collected logs. Default value: cdn\_log\_access\_l1. Valid values:

- **cdn\_log\_access\_l1**: access logs of L1 Dynamic Route for CDN (DCDN) points of presence (POPs)

- **cdn\_log\_origin**: back-to-origin logs

- **cdn\_log\_er**: EdgeRoutine logs

description.zh: 字段列表，多个字段用半角逗号（,）隔开。取值请参见[实时日志采集字段说明](~~324199~~)。
description.en: The list of fields. Separate multiple fields with commas (,). For more information, see [Fields in a real-time log](~~324199~~).

descriptions.en: > Each account can call this operation up to 100 times per second.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dcdn update-dcdn-user-real-time-delivery-field --business-type cdn_log_access_l1 --fields body_bytes_sent,client_ip,content_type --region cn-hangzhou
